2. It is submitted that due to certain social reasons when marriage of petitioner could not solemnize with O.P. No. 2, therefore on false pretext related with purchase, booking of hotel and other expenditure, present case was lodged.
It is submitted that prima-facie legal ingredient as to make out a case under Section 420 of the IPC, not appears available in Patna High Court CR.

Considering the aforesaid, let further proceeding qua petitioner in connection with C.A. No. 83 of 2023 pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Patna City, shall remain stayed till further order.
4. Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of O.P. No.
5.
Let notice be issued to opposite party no. 2 by both modes, ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks from today.
6. Re-notify this matter on 17.03.2025, position be retained.
